source.snippet: "I would love a Kagi MCP to give my agents a better web search tool but they don't seem interested. I would pay for this." — HN commenter on a thread about Kagi search, July 2026. Kagi has no official MCP server; users running AI coding agents and autonomous pipelines are forced to use inferior search tools or build ad-hoc wrappers.

problem_statement: Developers running AI agents (coding assistants, autonomous pipelines) lack a reliable, privacy-respecting MCP-compatible web search tool; Kagi has not shipped an official MCP server, leaving builders patching around the gap with inferior alternatives.
target_segment: AI/software developers and solo operators running LLM agent pipelines who already pay for Kagi or similar premium search subscriptions.
notes: Explicit willingness-to-pay stated ('I would pay for this'). Kagi subscribers already have a paid relationship with search; an unofficial MCP wrapper or hosted MCP-search proxy could charge a small monthly fee. Second HN commenter (Cider9986) also expressed paying for Kagi/Brave at $3/mo with Monero — general paid-search sentiment is present. Low competition: no dominant MCP search product for agents yet.
